coin_entries_shape_check.name: coin_entries_shape_check
coin_entries_shape_check.value:
case "coin_entries"."reason"
        when 'race' then "coin_entries"."race_id" is not null and "coin_entries"."amount" >= 0
        when 'badge' then "coin_entries"."badge" is not null and "coin_entries"."amount" > 0
        when 'purchase' then "coin_entries"."purchase_key" is not null and "coin_entries"."item" in ('poke-ball', 'pc-box', 'fire-stone', 'water-stone', 'thunder-stone', 'leaf-stone', 'moon-stone', 'sun-stone', 'shiny-stone', 'dusk-stone', 'dawn-stone', 'metal-coat', 'kings-rock', 'dragon-scale', 'up-grade', 'dubious-disc', 'protector', 'electirizer', 'magmarizer', 'reaper-cloth', 'razor-claw', 'razor-fang', 'oval-stone', 'deep-sea-tooth', 'deep-sea-scale', 'prism-scale') and "coin_entries"."quantity" > 0 and "coin_entries"."amount" < 0
        else "coin_entries"."amount" > 0 end

race_participants_inactive_alone_check.name: race_participants_inactive_alone_check
race_participants_inactive_alone_check.value: "race_participants"."inactive_at" is null or ("race_participants"."finished_at" is null and "race_participants"."abandoned_at" is null)

race_participants_settled_together_check.name: race_participants_settled_together_check
race_participants_settled_together_check.value: ("race_participants"."gross_wpm" is null) = ("race_participants"."score" is null) and ("race_participants"."score" is null) = ("race_participants"."accuracy" is null) and ("race_participants"."accuracy" is null) = ("race_participants"."place" is null)
